name: Further Instructions
summary: Ziz Fizziks sends stolen Venture Company plans from Windshear Crag to Ratchet. They may give his rival Sputtervalve an edge.

sections.title: Corporate Espionage
sections.body: Ziz Fizziks carries the Venture Company’s secrets from Windshear Crag. The company cast him out of its logging operations, and he took sensitive documents with him. He sealed internal manuals and technical schematics in an envelope bound for Ratchet. Among them are blueprints for the experimental Super Reaper 6000. Bitter over his dismissal, Fizziks hopes to find a buyer or ally willing to use what he stole.

sections.title: The Ratchet Connection
sections.body: In Ratchet, the neutral port in the Barrens, engineer Sputtervalve waits. He has little trust or affection for Fizziks, yet their common rival makes the offer hard to refuse. The Steamwheedle-aligned goblins seek ways to weaken the ruthless Venture Company. They eagerly reverse-engineer superior mechanical inventions they come across.

faq.q: What is inside the Sealed Envelope?
faq.answer: The envelope holds Venture Company documents, technical manuals, and blueprints for the Super Reaper 6000. Ziz Fizziks stole them when the company drove him from its logging operation.
Sputtervalve is a goblin engineer in Ratchet, in the Barrens. He distrusts Ziz Fizziks, but wants to weaken the Venture Company and study its machines.

faq.q: Why is Ziz Fizziks working against the Venture Company?
faq.answer: The Venture Company drove Fizziks from its ranks in Stonetalon. Bitter and seeking revenge, he began passing its trade secrets to rivals.
Sputtervalve is in Ratchet, a neutral port town on the eastern coast of the Barrens.
No. Sputtervalve distrusts Fizziks, but the manuals and blueprints matter more to him than his wariness of the messenger.
The Super Reaper 6000 is an advanced industrial shredder the Venture Company developed to clear forests and process lumber quickly. Its blueprints are highly coveted.

angles.text: The envelope bears the marks of goblin industry: corporate espionage, patent theft, and the reverse-engineering of complex lumber harvesters.
Carrying stolen Venture Company plans to Ratchet feeds trade rivalries that challenge industrial expansion near Horde territory.
